critical_code_review_comments: routes/services.py:51-62 list_service_providers — limit default 50 but to_list(limit) uses the cap; price_from computes min over services array client-side per call. For 2-3 providers per category this is negligible, fine as-is.

routes/services.py:84-107 admin_create_provider — no validation that body['services'] entries have id/name/price; passing malformed services would silently insert. Low risk because endpoint is admin-only, but a Pydantic model would harden it.

routes/services.py:170-217 create_service_booking — `category`/`service_name` accessed via body['category'] / body['service_name'] without explicit validation; will raise KeyError → 500 if missing. Consider Pydantic body model for clearer 422 responses (consistent with rest of codebase).

ondemand_seed.py:172-175 — providers are upserted by id; existing providers' services/prices won't be refreshed if seed changes. If catalog evolves, expect operator to clear collection or extend seed to overwrite. Documented behavior is fine.

Frontend userHomeServices.js — the 3 'Services à la demande' quick tiles + 'Plus de Services' use React Router navigation (no <a href>); recommend adding data-testid on each tile (e.g. home-ondemand-tile-{id}) for easier regression coverage.
